result.summary: The page is generally clean and consistent. Excluding the intentionally scrollable/clipped carousel items and bottom-viewport cutoff, the main finding is a bottom navigation state mismatch: the Profile tab appears selected while Home feed content is displayed.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows the Profile tab highlighted/active in green, while the visible content is the Home feed rather than the Profile screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the active tab state matches the current screen; highlight Home when the Home feed is shown, or navigate to Profile content if Profile is selected.
